positioning.statement: A direct kitchen stock system that shows what should exist, records what arrived or was used, and keeps every approved movement traceable.
positioning.promise: Workers can record stock truth quickly, while managers can see the difference between recipe theory and the kitchen's actual numbers.
reasonsToBelieve: Reviewed receipts, approved recipes, measured usage, physical counts, immutable stock events, and accountant exports

tensions: immutable history and simple correction workflows
recognitionCues: neutral canvas and white work zones

hierarchy: Show the current stock or production state
Show the expected number beside the actual number
Name the evidence and the next explicit posting action

selectedTerritory.sharedVisualGrammar: Neutral structural fields, white work surfaces, soft rounded boundaries, clear numeric evidence, compact operational labels, and one orange action signal per screen.
selectedTerritory.projectTranslationBoundary: References supply evidence and principles only; the approved project theme must be translated from this project's brief and must not copy a reference identity.

interpretations.source: BulkBite brand guide: substantial, straightforward, energetic, honest, and student-first

interpretations.source: User requirement that handwritten worker records and receipt evidence enter the system safely

selectedTerritory.name: Substantial kitchen truth
selectedTerritory.concept: A substantial kitchen field manual: stock truth is framed with the same bold, direct energy as the BulkBite customer brand, while dense work stays calm and legible.
selectedTerritory.sharedVisualGrammar: Neutral structural fields, white work surfaces, soft rounded boundaries, clear numeric evidence, compact operational labels, and one orange action signal per screen.
selectedTerritory.alignmentRhythm: A twelve-column desktop grid and reduced mobile flow use strong left axes, 8 px spacing increments, dense work zones, and generous separation around decisions.

references.source: BulkBite design system.txt and the public bulkbite.co.za HTML/CSS
references.evidence: Anton display type, #101010 ink, #F5F0E6 warm paper, #FF5A1F orange, large quantities, direct copy, and sharp rectangular framing.
references.principleToBorrow: Use scale and contrast to make the important quantity and next action obvious within seconds.
references.doNotCopy: Do not copy public sales-page content, food photography, or marketing-only interactions into the kitchen application.

references.source: BulkBite Poster Campaign: Final Creative Brief
references.evidence: Campaign compositions use one dominant statement, restrained orange emphasis, short supporting copy, and one tested action.
references.principleToBorrow: Each operational screen should have one dominant job and one clear posting action.
references.doNotCopy: Do not place poster slogans, tracked QR advertising, or unverified appetite claims in operational workflows.

selectedTerritory.typography: System sans owns page titles, quantities, instructions, forms, tables, metadata, and long reading. Operational hierarchy comes from weight and spacing, not display typography.
selectedTerritory.colorMaterial: A very light neutral canvas supports white work surfaces. Charcoal carries text, orange marks the primary action or current step, and muted grey carries low-priority context.
selectedTerritory.geometryLines: Soft one-pixel borders, 12 to 16 pixel surface radii, and 8 to 10 pixel control radii. Avoid sharp poster framing, floating pills, glossy depth, and gradients.
selectedTerritory.imagery: Use the supplied wordmark or symbol assets only. Operational meaning uses simple line icons and textual evidence. Food imagery is unnecessary in the stock app.
selectedTerritory.spacingDensity: Dashboard claims receive breathing room; forms and tables become compact where repeated entry benefits from density. Touch targets remain at least 44 px.
selectedTerritory.composition: Every workflow moves from current state to evidence, entry, review, and one explicit posting action. Mobile stacks this order without hiding units or status.
selectedTerritory.motion: Fast state confirmation and short directional transitions. Reduced motion renders the final hierarchy immediately, with no information depending on movement.
selectedTerritory.systemCompatibility: Desyium theme tokens own color, type, radius, spacing treatment, motion policy, and prohibitions. Frappe UI component owners supply operational controls through generated System exports. Blocks own workflow composition.
selectedTerritory.projectTranslationBoundary: References supply evidence and principles only; the approved project theme must be translated from this project's brief and must not copy a reference identity.

activeTheme.name: BulkBite Operations
activeTheme.purpose: Provide a self-explanatory BulkBite stock dashboard with a restrained charcoal-and-muted-orange shell around calm neutral operational work surfaces

composition.hierarchy: Use a compact page title, one-sentence purpose, visible workflow stages, one main work area, and a separate review or posting boundary.
composition.negativeSpace: Use calm dashboard spacing. Group each decision with its evidence and next action while keeping repeated rows efficient.
composition.geometry: Use a compact collapsible soft-charcoal setup rail, one calm muted-orange top area, separated horizontal workflow navigation, neutral work surfaces, soft borders, and generous but consistent rounding.
composition.density: Keep forms and tables efficient without making the task feel cramped. Touch targets remain at least 44 pixels high.
composition.lighting: Use restrained surface elevation and tonal separation. No decorative lighting, gradients, textures, or atmospheric effects.

componentTreatment.buttons: Use ordinary Frappe UI button sizing with explicit labels and rounded geometry. Workflow tabs use separated low-contrast segments with a light active surface and dark indicator. Refresh has a fixed footprint and a strictly bounded loading indicator.
componentTreatment.forms: Frappe UI behavior with persistent labels, 44 pixel targets, consistent internal padding, tinted field surfaces, visible units, direct help, explicit errors, and raised neutral popovers.
componentTreatment.cards: Use tinted work surfaces with soft borders and 14 to 16 pixel rounding. Reserve the brightest surface for the current decision or open popover.

primitiveTreatment.rule: Keep solid-field available as the required fallback primitive, but do not mount visual primitives in ordinary operations views. Structure comes from flow, spacing, semantic surface levels, and soft borders.

recipeTreatment.rule: Keep precision-frame available for an exceptional evidence boundary, but do not apply decorative recipes to ordinary operational pages.

blockTreatment.rhythm: Orient the user, show numbered stages, present one current work area, then expose review and posting as an explicit final boundary.

motion.character: Still by default. Use only provider-native state transitions required for control feedback.
motion.reduced: Render final state immediately; no meaning or hierarchy depends on movement.

activeTheme.responsive: Protect state, units, evidence, and action order. Collapse columns before reducing targets or hiding labels.
prohibitions: Use muted orange only for the top shell area, active workflow emphasis, warnings that require it, and the primary action. Routine keyboard focus uses neutral high contrast.
Do not use Anton, campaign slogans, oversized all-caps headings, black feature panels, or poster composition in the dashboard.
Do not mount decorative primitives, recipes, or entrance experiences in operational views.
Do not use gradients, glossy surfaces, bright campaign-orange fields, non-collapsible dominant sidebars, or decorative panels.
Do not use white, warm paper, paper shadow, or another near-white value for the sidebar or top shell area.
Do not make the canvas, sidebar, work panels, fields, and popovers the same white surface.
Do not place raw controls in pages when a selected System owner exists.
Do not hide posting, reconciliation, or review state behind menus.
Do not use accounting dimensions in worker entry workflows.

audienceConsequence.risk: This page fails when Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile cannot identify the next relevant action from the ordered blocks.
audienceConsequence.consequence: The Open and complete the next required operational task action must stay reachable, legible, and justified by the preceding content.
audienceConsequence.validationPrompt: Can Signed-in BulkBite staff deciding what to update, buy, receive, cook, measure, report, and reconcile understand the page purpose, locate the main action, and recover if a block fails or is skipped?
audienceConsequence.fallback: If motion, rich surfaces, or optional blocks fail, render the review-today -> complete-workflow -> manage-exceptions -> maintain-system -> ai-upload-review -> structured-importer sequence as readable semantic sections.

alignment.localLayoutRule: The page grid establishes territories. Each block then selects grid, flex, stack, overlay, or flow from its content relationship.
alignment.intentionalOffsets: Any offset must repeat as a page rule; isolated nudges are prohibited.

rhythm.densityProgression: Alternate expansive orientation, compact proof, structured explanation, and decisive action; adjacent blocks must not all carry equal density.
rhythm.verticalCadence: Use one page spacing scale and make section padding changes correspond to narrative importance.
rhythm.adjacency: Block edges meet deliberately; accidental gaps, floating islands, and unrelated container widths are prohibited.

surfaceDistribution.rule: Spend the strongest contrast and richest surface treatment on the focal block; ambient treatments dissolve into their owning field and adjacent surfaces without arbitrary straight seams.

focalHierarchy.rule: Each block must have one focal job and must hand attention to the next block without competing with the page promise.

motifContract.removalRule: No persistent guide, rail, line, or motif exists unless a project brand contract explicitly enables and proves it.

principleContract.traceRule: Every block decision cites principle authority for responsibility, hierarchy, spacing, layout, expression, surface, and motion.
principleContract.rejectionRule: Reject technically valid output when geometry, spacing, layout strategy, surface ownership, action treatment, or motion is arbitrary or untraceable.

motionPlan.signatureRule: Select at most one or two semantic signature mechanisms; Three.js, pinning, FLIP, and card effects require a brand or narrative reason.
motionPlan.reducedMotion: Every experience has a readable final-state equivalent and deterministic teardown.

primitiveGrammar.sharedTopology: Use one coherent topology and origin across the page rather than unrelated effect families.
primitiveGrammar.sharedOrigin: Visual layers align to the page grid, focal content, or a named transition seam; arbitrary origins are prohibited.
primitiveGrammar.removalRule: Every layer must name its hierarchy, structure, continuity, or material job; remove it when the page communicates equally well without it.
primitiveGrammar.edgeContinuity: Ambient primitive layers occupy the full semantic owner and dissolve into its field through fade or continuous color. A sharp edge is permitted only around a semantically bounded object.

connectionContract.dedicatedBlockRule: A connector normally lives in how one block ends, how the next begins, or both edges sharing a field. Insert a dedicated block only when the connector owns meaningful content, narrative, or an intermediate audience state.
connectionContract.gradientRule: Resolve the relationship from both block descriptions first, then compile one full-pair field with a stable substrate, named energy direction, off-boundary source when needed, sufficient falloff depth, and responsive geometry.

componentJobs.job: Present one quantitative proof point with label and qualification.
Navigate to another resource or location.

recipeSuggestions.purpose: Define a focal territory through restrained frame, corner, and edge-light signals without turning content into another card.
Express measured technical authority through one grid, one controlled signal origin, and restrained material texture.
Build a controlled radial technology motif around one focal subject without becoming a generic sci-fi background.

request.responsibility: Restore BulkBite operational system context across planning, stock truth logic, Frappe contracts, generated app source, and design-system owners.
decisions: Frappe owns auth database permissions APIs and stock event posting
manager approvals create immutable stock events
constraints: ERPNext is not a runtime dependency
generated Desyium internals are not edited by hand
component code imports public System exports

systemInvariants: Copy canonical CSS verbatim and extend it only at the canonical source.
Pages and blocks import through @/desyium; raw provider imports are forbidden there.
Search component jobs, executable records, primitives, recipes, and blocks before creating project source.
Large layouts use 12 columns, intermediate layouts use 8, and mobile recomposes hierarchy instead of merely shrinking it.
The page grid establishes shared territories; local relationships deliberately select grid, flex, stack, overlay, or normal flow.
Internal padding defines an object while external gap defines its relationship to neighboring objects.
Persistent rails, guide lines, and motifs are opt-in brand decisions with semantic purpose, responsive form, and a removal rule.
Each block owns one audience-state change, a content contract, component jobs, primitive roles, responsive behavior, and a success measure.
Ordered blocks explicitly hand off to the next block.
Transitions bridge meaning and structure; primitives render their visual expression.
rejectionConditions: A known control is rebuilt in a page or block.
Primitive CSS is recreated locally instead of selected, composed, or contributed.
A brand is reduced to colors and fonts without composition, material, motion, voice, and prohibitions.
A technically valid layout passes despite arbitrary spacing, surface ownership, action styling, or motion.
A block exists only for visual variety.
Adjacent blocks have incompatible outgoing and incoming states.
A transition disguises a missing narrative handoff.
validationPrompts: Which system record owns every reusable decision?
Can a clean consumer reproduce this without chat history?
What does the visitor know or do after this block?
Why is the next block the correct next state?
Does the transition reinforce that handoff?

authority: Project brief, selected structured territory, and approved project brand authority
System* public wrappers, visual recipes, executable blocks, and page blueprint
